reading.title: PAYMENT IN LIEU OF TAXES AND REGULATORY AGREEMENT

candidates.quote: The Owner shall pay the City an annual payment in lieu of taxes equal to 25 percent of the property taxes that would otherwise be due, for a period of 15 years.
candidates.value: 25 percent of property taxes for 15 years

candidates.quote: The Owner shall reserve 16 of the 80 homes in the Project as Affordable Homes.
Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 60 percent of Area Median Income.
Monthly rent for each Affordable Home, including a utility allowance, shall not exceed the 60 percent rent limit based on the HUD income limits published each year.
The requirements of this Article 3 shall remain in effect for 30 years from the date the first Affordable Home is leased.
The Owner is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner of the Project.
The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by March 1 of each year.
If a default is not cured within 60 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay all abated taxes with interest.
candidates.value: Repay all abated taxes with interest

candidates.quote: This Agreement shall be recorded and runs with the land.
